input.objective: Weir Townies: AUDIT ONLY, ROUND 2 (round 1 findings fixed: royalty follows the treasury and is capped, renounceOwnership reverts, cap arithmetic widened, zero withdraw reverts, freezeMetadata, endSale + owner sweeps). Review src/WeirTownies.sol from this repository as it arrives (do not edit src/, test/, foundry.toml or lib/) and report findings; do NOT deploy anything, do NOT create a token, pool, distributor or website. The owner deploys from script/Deploy.s.sol with their own key after findings at medium or above are fixed. Context: an ERC-721 (OpenZeppelin v5.5.0: ERC721, ERC721Enumerable, ERC2981, Ownable2Step, MerkleProof, ReentrancyGuard) for 3,333 tokens on Robinhood Chain (chainId 4663, Arbitrum Orbit, cancun). Token ids are laid out by the owner before the sale (setLayout, sealPools): an owner-minted reserve, then role pools each with its own Merkle root and a one-claim-per-wallet rule, then the general range sold first to a Merkle allowlist and then publicly at an ETH price with a per-wallet cap of 3. Metadata is off-chain at baseURI + id and the contract emits ERC-4906 events from an updater address. Money: msg.value must equal price x qty; withdraw() sends the balance to the treasury and anyone may call it. Please look hardest at: the id layout arithmetic (ranges never overlap, never exceed MAX_SUPPLY, no id minted twice), the Merkle leaf encoding (double keccak of abi.encode(address)) and proof misuse across pools, the per-wallet caps, reentrancy through _safeMint receivers, owner powers after the sale (nothing should touch sold tokens), and the withdraw path. Build: forge build && forge test (20 tests incl. fuzz and a reentrant receiver). Report any finding at medium or above and block on high or critical. Do not claim an independent audit.
